description_en: Calls the GetImage operation to get image information from a media set
description_zh: 调用GetImage接口从媒体集中获取一张图片的信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-image --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/face1.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetImage

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri
